notes: Vite browser app: the SDK is initialised in the entry module that index.html loads. The token is read from import.meta.env.VITE_BUGSEE_APP_TOKEN, which Vite inlines at build time from .env.local (git-ignored); set VITE_BUGSEE_APP_TOKEN in CI and hosting builds too, otherwise the production bundle has no token. The init is guarded: a build without the variable ships no Bugsee.  If the Vite config sets envDir, envPrefix or root, the wizard uses the browser recipe with a literal token instead. launch() runs after the entry's imports have been evaluated (imports are hoisted), before the rest of the entry. Only this package is scanned for an existing integration: a launch in another workspace package is not seen.
